about: Mobic and Eliquis are supplied by brand only on 6 June 2026 to an adult, so the oral NSAID and oral anticoagulant are concurrent.

The oral rivaroxaban course supplied on 6 February 2026 overlaps the rectal diclofenac supplied on 12 February. The nearby diclofenac gel is topical and the two naproxen supplies are outside the 60-day window.
Naprosyn was supplied on 6 January 2026 and Xarelto on 6 June 2026, 151 days apart, so the supplies do not overlap and are more than 60 days apart.
